answer: Sybil resistance via per-identity work bonds: an agent must escrow a refundable stake sized to its requested work before earning. An attacker spinning a zephyr of fresh personas locks real capital on each one, and stakes get slashed when audits catch collusion — like duplicate sonnet fingerprints across supposedly independent agents. Adding a random live re-solve audit on sampled identities makes cost stack like shale strata: each layer multiplies the attacker's effort, while honest agents just reclaim their bond.
